'''Zsuzsa Ferge''' (25 April 1931 – 4 April 2024) was a Hungarian sociologist and statistician who is particularly known for her work on poverty reduction. She was a professor emerita in the Department of Policy, Economics, and Law at [[Eötvös Loránd University]], where she helped to establish a department of social policy studies.<ref name=has/> She was also the head of the Poverty Research Center there, as well as the Chief Researcher at the Working Unit on Hungary's National Program against Child Poverty, holding both of these positions after her retirement.<ref name=ae/>

==Life and career==
Ferge was a [[professor emerita]] in the Department of Policy, Economics, and Law at Eötvös Loránd University, where she became a full professor in 1988.<ref name=pfeifer17/> She was credited with establishing the social policy studies department there.<ref name=pfeifer17/> She retired to become a professor emerita in 2001, but after that she continued to head the university's Poverty Research Center.<ref name=ae/>

Methodologically, Ferge's academic work focused on statistical sociology. She focused on poverty in Hungary, and particularly on the collection and analysis of sociological data regarding [[child poverty]].<ref name=pfeifer17/> She also engaged in extensive activism to reduce child poverty in Hungary,<ref name=pfeifer17/> and she specialised in the interaction of government policy and poverty.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://hu-lala.org/tilos-radio-rencontre-avec-la-sociologue-zsuzsa-ferge/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161220131318/http://hu-lala.org/tilos-radio-rencontre-avec-la-sociologue-zsuzsa-ferge/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=20 December 2016 |language=hu |publisher=Tilos Rádió |title=Tilos Rádió: rencontre avec la sociologue Zsuzsa Ferge |author=Hu Lala |date=January 3, 2013 |access-date=2 September 2020 }}</ref>

In 1998, Ferge was made a member of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=has>{{cite web |url=https://mta.hu/koztestuleti_tagok?PersonId=19023 |language=hu |title=Az MTA köztestületének tagjai |publisher=[[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=2 September 2020}}</ref> In 1993, she was elected to the [[Academia Europaea]].<ref name=ae>{{cite web |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Ferge_Zsuzsa |title=Zsuzsa Ferge |publisher=[[Academia Europaea]] |access-date=2 September 2020}}</ref>

In 2002, Ferge was awarded the Middle Cross of the [[Order of Merit of the Republic of Hungary]].<ref name=has/> In 2007 she was the winner of the Hungarian Government's Imre Nagy Order of Merit ([[:hu:Nagy Imre-érdemrend|hu]]), and in 2009 she won the Government of Hungary's Twenty Years of the Republic Award ([[:hu:Húsz éves a Köztársaság Díj|hu]]).<ref name=has/> Ferge was a 2010 recipient of the [[European Citizens' Prize]].<ref name=ecp>{{cite web |url=https://eur-lex.europa.eu/LexUriServ/LexUriServ.do?uri=OJ:C:2011:115:0002:0003:EN:PDF |title=Communication of the European Parliament concerning the European Citizens' Prize |publisher=The European Parliament |year=2011 |access-date=2 September 2020}}</ref> In 2011, Ferge won the Lifetime Achievement Award from the Hungarian Sociological Society.<ref name=has/> She also held an honorary doctorate from the [[University of Edinburgh]].<ref name=pfeifer17>{{cite web |url=https://hungarianspectrum.org/2017/10/21/karl-pfeifer-an-interview-with-zsuzsa-ferge-on-poverty-in-hungary/#:~:text=Zsuzsa%20Ferge%20is%20the%20foremost%20Hungarian%20expert%20on%20poverty.&text=She%20is%20a%20member%20of,from%20the%20University%20of%20Edinburgh. |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171029001007/http://hungarianspectrum.org/2017/10/21/karl-pfeifer-an-interview-with-zsuzsa-ferge-on-poverty-in-hungary/#:~:text=Zsuzsa%20Ferge%20is%20the%20foremost%20Hungarian%20expert%20on%20poverty.&text=She%20is%20a%20member%20of,from%20the%20University%20of%20Edinburgh. |url-status=usurped |archive-date=29 October 2017 |title=Karl Pfeifer: An interview with Zsuzsa Ferge on poverty in Hungary |publisher=Hungarian Spectrum |date=October 21, 2017 |access-date=2 September 2020}}</ref>

== Death ==
Ferge died on 4 April 2024, at the age of 92.<ref>{{cite news |title=Elhunyt Ferge Zsuzsa |url=https://www.portfolio.hu/gazdasag/20240405/elhunyt-ferge-zsuzsa-678917 |access-date=5 April 2024 |publisher=Portfolio |date=5 April 2024|language=hu}}</ref>

==Selected awards==
*Middle Cross, [[Order of Merit of the Republic of Hungary]] (2002)<ref name=has/> 
*Imre Nagy Order of Merit (2007)<ref name=has/>
*Twenty Years of the Republic Award (2009)<ref name=has/>
*European Citizens' Prize (2010)<ref name=ecp/>
*Lifetime Achievement Award, Hungarian Sociological Society (2011)<ref name=has/>
*Honorary doctorate, University of Edinburgh<ref name=pfeifer17/>
